title: Identification of Small Molecule Ligand Binding Sites On and In the ARNT PAS-B Domain.
authors: Xu, Xingjian; Closson, Joseph; Marcelino, Leandro Pimentel; Favaro, Denize C; Silvestrini, Marion L; Solazzo, Riccardo; Chong, Lillian T; Gardner, Kevin H
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文结合NMR、MD模拟和集合对接鉴定ARNT PAS-B结构域上的小分子配体结合热点，虽聚焦蛋白-小分子而非TF-DNA互作，但其对蛋白结构域内/表面结合位点的动态建模与对接方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面研究，故给予中档分。
abstract: Transcription factors are generally challenging to target with small molecule inhibitors due to their structural plasticity and lack of catalytic sites. Notable exceptions include several naturally ligand-regulated transcription factors, including our prior work with the heterodimeric HIF-2 transcription factor which showed that small molecule binding within an internal pocket of the HIF-2alpha PAS-B domain can disrupt its interactions with its dimerization partner, ARNT. Here, we explore the feasibility of similarly targeting small molecules to the analogous ARNT PAS-B domain itself, potentially opening a promising route to simultaneously modulate several ARNT-mediated signaling pathways. Using solution NMR screening of an in-house fragment library, we previously identified several compounds that bind ARNT PAS-B and, in certain cases, antagonize ARNT association with the TACC3 transcriptional coactivator. However, these ligands have only modest binding affinities, complicating characterization of their binding sites. We address this challenge by combining NMR, MD simulations, and ensemble docking to identify ligand-binding 'hotspots' on and within the ARNT PAS-B domain. Our data indicate that the two ARNT/TACC3 inhibitors, KG-548 and KG-655, bind to a beta-sheet surface implicated in both HIF-2 dimerization and coactivator recruitment. Furthermore, while KG-548 binds exclusively to the beta-sheet surface, KG-655 can additionally bind within a water-accessible internal cavity in ARNT PAS-B. Finally, KG-279, while not a coactivator inhibitor, exemplifies ligands that preferentially bind only to the internal cavity. All three ligands promoted ARNT PAS-B homodimerization, albeit to varying degrees. Taken together, our findings provide a comprehensive overview of ARNT PAS-B ligand-binding sites and may guide the development of more potent coactivator inhibitors for cellular and functional studies.
abstract_zh: 转录因子通常因其结构可塑性和缺乏催化位点而难以用小分子抑制剂靶向。显著的例外包括若干天然配体调控的转录因子，其中包括我们先前对异二聚体HIF-2转录因子的研究，该研究表明小分子结合于HIF-2α PAS-B结构域的内部口袋内可破坏其与二聚化伙伴ARNT的相互作用。在此，我们探索类似地将小分子靶向同源的ARNT PAS-B结构域本身的可行性，这可能为同时调节多种ARNT介导的信号通路开辟一条有前景的途径。通过使用内部片段库的溶液NMR筛选，我们先前鉴定了若干结合ARNT PAS-B的化合物，并在某些情况下拮抗ARNT与TACC3转录共激活因子的结合。然而，这些配体仅具有适度的结合亲和力，这使其结合位点的表征复杂化。我们通过结合NMR、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和整体对接来识别ARNT PAS-B结构域上及其内部的配体结合“热点”，从而应对这一挑战。我们的数据表明，两种ARNT/TACC3抑制剂KG-548和KG-655结合于一个β-折叠表面，该表面涉及HIF-2二聚化和共激活因子招募。此外，虽然KG-548仅结合于β-折叠表面，KG-655还可额外结合于ARNT PAS-B内一个水可及的内腔。最后，KG-279虽然不是共激活因子抑制剂，但代表了优先仅结合内腔的配体。所有三种配体均促进ARNT PAS-B同二聚化，尽管程度不同。综合来看，我们的发现提供了ARNT PAS-B配体结合位点的全面概述，并可能指导开发用于细胞和功能研究的更有效共激活因子抑制剂。
